boundary_verdict: Only 11 of 15 sit inside the City of Vancouver. Capilano, Grouse, Lynn Canyon, Deep Cove are District of North Vancouver; Cypress and Lions Gate's north end are West Vancouver. MOA, Nitobe and Wreck Beach are UBC/University Endowment Lands, unincorporated Electoral Area A. Near-misses: Art Gallery, Science World, Kits Beach, BC Place.
